title: Concept: Loan restructuring flag exposed
description: A restructured flag on a loan object in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A restructuring flag records that a loan was rescheduled under distress, and it follows the borrower into future credit decisions, so it is sensitive even when the balance is public.
applicability: Deployments that render a restructured flag on a loan object into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A restructuring flag records that a loan was rescheduled under distress, and it follows the borrower into future credit decisions, so it is sensitive even when the balance is public.
